name: Angorodon's Gaze
description: Spell. Steals {{LifeStealing}} Health. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy if you have a condition.

name: Animate Bone Fiend
description: Spell. Creates a level {{Level}} bone fiend that can attack at range. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Animate Bone Horror
description: Spell. Creates a level {{Level}} bone horror. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Animate Bone Minions
description: Spell. Creates two level {{Level}} bone minions. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Animate Flesh Golem
description: Elite Spell. Creates a level {{Level}} flesh golem which leaves a fresh corpse when it dies. Exploits a fresh corpse. You can have only one flesh golem at a time.

name: Animate Shambling Horror
description: Spell. Creates a level {{ShamblingHorrorLevel}} shambling horror. When the shambling horror dies, it is replaced by a level {{JaggedHorrorLevel}} jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Animate Vampiric Horror
description: Spell. Creates a level {{Level}} vampiric horror. You gain Health equal to the damage it deals. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Atrophy
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Reduces this foe's primary attribute to 0.

name: Aura of the Lich
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Exploit all corpses in earshot. Animates a level {{Level}} bone horror, plus one for each exploited corpse. You have +1 Death Magic ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Awaken the Blood
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +2 Blood Magic and Curses. Sacrifice 50% more Health than normal.

name: Barbed Signet
description: Signet. Target and adjacent foes suffer from Bleeding ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds).

name: Barbs
description: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Target foe takes {{Damage}} damage whenever it takes physical damage.

name: Bitter Chill
description: Spell. Deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage. Recharges instantly if target foe had more Health than you.

name: Blood Bond
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to your target ({{Duration}} seconds). Allies hitting these foes gain {{HealthGain}} health. If any of these foes dies while hexed, adjacent allies are healed for {{Healing}}.

name: Blood Drinker
description: Spell. Steals {{LifeStealing}} Health. You begin Bleeding (10 seconds) if your Health is above 50%.

name: Blood Renewal
description: Enchantment Spell. (7 seconds.) You have +{{Regeneration}} Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for {{Healing}}.

name: Blood Ritual
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) +3 Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.

name: Blood is Power
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) +{{EnergyRegeneration}} Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.

name: Blood of the Aggressor
description: Spell. Steal {{LifeStealing}} Health. Inflicts Weakness ({{WeaknessDuration}} seconds) if target foe was attacking.

name: Blood of the Master
description: Spell. Heals your undead servants for {{Healing}}. Healing cost: +2% Health sacrifice per servant healed.

name: Cacophony
description: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Deals {{Damage}} damage whenever target foe uses a shout or chant.

name: Chilblains
description: Spell. Deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage to foes in the area around your target; removes {{EnchantmentsRemoved}} enchantment[s] from these foes. You are Poisoned (10 seconds).

name: Consume Corpse
description: Spell. Teleport to a corpse's location. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health and {{EnergyGain}} Energy. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Contagion
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Whenever you gain a condition, all foes in the area gain that same condition. You sacrifice {{SacrificePercent}}% maximum Health each time this happens.

name: Corrupt Enchantment
description: Elite Hex Spell. Removes one enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration (10 seconds).

name: Cultist's Fervor
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5 seconds plus 3 seconds more for every rank of Soul Reaping.) Your Necromancer spells cost {{EnergyReduction}} less Energy. You suffer from Bleeding (10 seconds) each time you cast a Necromancer spell.

name: Dark Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds). Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage to adjacent foes whenever target ally sacrifices Health. Damage cost: you lose {{HealthLoss}} Health.

name: Dark Bond
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Transfers 75% of incoming damage from you to your nearest servant.

name: Dark Fury
description: Enchantment Spell. Enchants party members (5 seconds). These party members gain one strike of adrenaline each time they hit with an attack. 50% failure chance unless Blood Magic 5 or more.

name: Dark Pact
description: Spell. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage.

name: Death Nova
description: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals {{Damage}} damage and inflicts Poisoned condition (15 seconds) on adjacent foes if target ally dies.

name: Deathly Chill
description: Spell. Deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.

name: Deathly Swarm
description: Spell. Deathly Swarm flies out slowly and deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage. Hits two additional foes in the area.

name: Defile Defenses
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Deals {{Damage}} damage the next time target foe blocks.

name: Defile Enchantments
description: Spell. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage to target and nearby foes. Deals {{DamagePerEnchantment}} more damage for each enchantment on them.

name: Defile Flesh
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Reduces healing target foe receives by 33%. Only skills with the word "heal" in the description are affected.

name: Demonic Flesh
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) When using a skill on a foe, deal {{ShadowDamage}} shadow damage to all other foes adjacent to you.

name: Depravity
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Causes {{EnergyLost}} Energy loss whenever target foe casts a spell. One foe near your target also loses Energy.

name: Desecrate Enchantments
description: Spell. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage to target and nearby foes. Deals {{DamagePerEnchantment}} more damage for each enchantment on them.

name: Discord
description: Elite Spell. Deals {{ArmorignoringDamage}} damage. No effect unless target foe has a condition and is either hexed or enchanted.

name: Discord (PvP)
description: Elite Spell. Deals {{Damage}} damage. No effect unless target foe has a condition and is either hexed or enchanted.

name: Enfeeble
description: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Enfeeble (PvP)
description: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Enfeebling Blood
description: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{Duration}} seconds) on this foe and nearby foes.

name: Enfeebling Blood (PvP)
description: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{Duration}} second[s]) on this foe and nearby foes.

name: Enfeebling Touch
description: Touch Skill. Causes {{HealthLoss}} Health loss. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Envenom Enchantments
description: Spell. Removes one enchantment from target foe. Inflicts Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds for each remaining enchantment on that foe).

name: Faintheartedness
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe attacks 50% slower and has -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration.

name: Feast for the Dead
description: Spell. Destroys one of your undead servants. Heals your servants for {{Healing}}.

name: Feast of Corruption
description: Elite Spell. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage to target and adjacent foes. Steal {{LifeStealing}} Health from each hexed foe.

name: Fetid Ground
description: Spell. Deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds) if target foe is knocked-down.

name: Foul Feast
description: Spell. Transfers all conditions from target ally to yourself. You gain {{Healing}} Health and {{EnergyGain}} Energy for each condition transferred. Half recharge if you remove Disease. Cannot self-target.

name: Gaze of Contempt
description: Spell. Removes target foe's enchantments. No effect unless this foe has more than 50% Health.

name: Grenth's Balance
description: Elite Spell. You gain Health equal to half the difference between you and target, and this foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose Health equal to half the difference.

name: Hexer's Vigor
description: Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) You have +{{HealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration. Ends if you use a non-hex skill.

name: Icy Veins
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Deals {{ColdDamageUponDeath}} cold damage to nearby foes if target foe dies. Initial effect: deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage.

name: Infuse Condition
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Whenever you receive a condition, it transfers from you to your closest undead servant.

name: Insidious Parasite
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Steal {{LifeStealing}} Health whenever target foe hits with an attack.

name: Jagged Bones
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) When target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level {{Level}} jagged horror that inflicts Bleeding with attacks.

name: Jaundiced Gaze
description: Enchantment Spell. Removes an enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: your next enchantment casts {{EnchantmentCastReduction}} second[s] faster and costs {{EnchantmentCostReduction}} less Energy. ({{Duration}} second[s])

name: Life Siphon
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe has -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration. You have +{{HealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration.

name: Life Transfer
description: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target ({{Duration}} second). Causes -{{HealthDegenerationRegeneration}} Health degeneration. You have +{{HealthDegenerationRegeneration}} Health regeneration.

name: Lifebane Strike
description: Spell. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage. Steals {{LifeStealing}} Health if target foe's Health is above 50%.

name: Lingering Curse
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target and nearby foes have -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration and receive 20% less benefit from healing.

name: Malaise
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Causes -1 Energy degeneration. Deals {{Damage}} damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. You have -1 Health degeneration. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.

name: Malign Intervention
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe receives 20% less from healing. If this foe dies while suffering from this hex, a level {{Level}} masterless bone horror is summoned.

name: Mark of Fury
description: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Allies hitting target foe gain {{AdrenalineGain}} strike[s] of adrenaline. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor ({{CrackedArmorDuration}} second[s].)

name: Mark of Pain
description: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage to adjacent foes whenever target foe takes physical damage.

name: Mark of Subversion
description: Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) Target foe's next spell fails and you steal {{LifeStealing}} Health. No effect unless this foe's spell targeted one of its allies.

name: Masochism
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +2 Death Magic and Soul Reaping. Sacrifice {{SacrificePercent}}% Health when you cast a spell.

name: Masochism (PvP)
description: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy whenever you sacrifice Health.

name: Meekness
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of target ({{Duration}} seconds). These foes attack 50% slower.

name: Necrosis
description: Skill. Deals {{ArmorignoringDamage}} damage if target foe has a condition or hex.

name: Necrotic Traversal
description: Spell. Teleport to a corpse's location. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...17...20 seconds). Affects all nearby foes. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Offering of Blood
description: Elite Spell. You gain 8...18...20 Energy.

name: Oppressive Gaze
description: Spell. Deals 10...26...30 damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Poison and Weakness (3...10...12 second) on foes suffering from a condition.

name: Order of Apostasy
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds). These party members remove one enchantment when they deal physical damage. Removal cost: for each Monk enchantment, you lose 25...17...15% maximum Health.

name: Order of Pain
description: Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds). 3...13...16 more damage whenever these party members hit with physical damage.

name: Order of Undeath
description: Elite Spell. (5 seconds.) Your undead servants deal +{{Damage}} damage. You lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever your servants hit.

name: Order of the Vampire
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members (5 seconds.) These party members steal {{LifeStealing}} Health with each physical damage attack. Party members under another Necromancer enchantment are not affected.

name: Pain of Disenchantment
description: Elite Spell. Target foe loses {{EnchantmentsRemoved}} enchantment[s]. Removal effect: that foe and all adjacent foes lose {{HealthLoss}} Health.

name: Parasitic Bond
description: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) Causes -1 Health degeneration. End effect: you are healed for {{Healing}} Health.

name: Plague Sending
description: Spell. Transfer {{ConditionsTransferred}} condition[s] and [its/their] remaining duration[s] from yourself to target foe and all adjacent foes.

name: Plague Signet
description: Elite Signet. Transfers all conditions with {{DurationPercent}}% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. 50% failure chance unless Curses 5 or more.

name: Plague Touch
description: Touch Skill. Transfers {{ConditionsTransferred}} condition[s] from yourself to target foe.

name: Poisoned Heart
description: Spell. Inflicts Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds) to adjacent foes. You are also Poisoned.

name: Price of Failure
description: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) 25% chance to miss. Target foe takes {{Damage}} damage whenever it fails to hit.

name: Putrid Bile
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Causes -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration. Deals {{Damage}} damage to all nearby foes if target foe dies.

name: Putrid Explosion
description: Spell. Explodes a corpse, dealing {{Damage}} damage to foes near it. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Putrid Flesh
description: Spell. Destroys one of your undead servants. Inflicts Diseased condition ({{Duration}} seconds) to foes near this servant.

name: Ravenous Gaze
description: Elite Spell. Deals {{Damage}} damage and steals {{LifeStealing}} Health from target and nearby foes.

name: Reaper's Mark
description: Elite Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Causes -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy if target foe dies while suffering from this hex.

name: Reckless Haste
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to your target ({{Duration}} seconds). These foes have 50% chance to miss, but attack 25% faster.

name: Rend Enchantments
description: Spell. Removes {{EnchantmentsRemoved}} enchantments from target foe. Removal cost: you lose {{HealthLoss}} Health for each Monk enchantment removed.

name: Rigor Mortis
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe cannot block.

name: Rip Enchantment
description: Spell. Removes 1 enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Bleeding ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds).

name: Rising Bile
description: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) End effect: deals {{Damage}} damage for each second Rising Bile was in effect. Also damages other foes in the area.

name: Rotting Flesh
description: Spell. Inflicts Diseased condition ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Shadow Strike
description: Spell. Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage. Steal up to {{LifeStealing}} Health if this foe was above 50% Health.

name: Shadow of Fear
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target ({{Duration}} seconds). They attack 50% slower.

name: Shivers of Dread
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. Interruption cost: you lose {{EnergyLoss}} Energy or this hex ends.

name: Signet of Agony
description: Signet. Deals {{Damage}} damage to foes near you. You begin Bleeding (25 seconds).

name: Signet of Agony (PvP)
description: Signet. Deals {{Damage}} damage to foes near you. You begin Bleeding (25 seconds).

name: Signet of Corruption
description: Signet. Deals {{Damage}} damage to target and nearby foes. You gain 2 Energy (maximum {{MaximumEnergyGain}}) for each of these foes with a condition or hex.

name: Signet of Lost Souls
description: Signet. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health and {{EnergyGain}} Energy if target foe is below 50% Health.

name: Signet of Sorrow
description: Signet. Deals {{Damage}} damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet.

name: Signet of Suffering
description: Elite Signet. You Bleed for 6 seconds. Applies Bleeding ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds) to the target of your next Necromancer skill.

name: Soul Barbs
description: Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals {{Damage}} damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on target foe.

name: Soul Bind
description: Elite Hex Spell. (30 seconds.) Every time target foe is healed, the healer takes {{Damage}} damage. Ends if target is suffering from a Smiting Prayers hex.

name: Soul Feast
description: Spell. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Soul Leech
description: Elite Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Steal {{LifeStealing}} Health whenever target foe casts a spell.

name: Soul Taker
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Attacks deal +{{Damage}} damage and sacrifice {{Sacrifice}} health. PvE Skill

name: Spinal Shivers
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Cold damage interrupts target foe's skills. Interruption cost: you lose {{EnergyLoss}} Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.

name: Spiteful Spirit
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Deals {{ShadowDamage}} damage to target and adjacent foes whenever this foe attacks or uses a skill.

name: Spoil Victor
description: Elite Hex Spell. (3...13...15 seconds.) Causes 25...85...100 Health loss whenever target foe attacks or casts spells on a creature with less Health.

name: Spoil Victor (PvP)
description: Elite Hex Spell. (3...13...15 seconds.) Causes 15...63...75 Health loss whenever target foe attacks or casts spells on a creature with less Health.

name: Strip Enchantment
description: Spell. Removes 0...2...2 enchantment[s] from target foe. Removal effect: you steal 5...53...65 Health.

name: Suffering
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near target (6...25...30 seconds). These foes have -0...2...3 Health degeneration.

name: Summon Spirits
description: Spell. Spirits you control Shadow Step to your location and gain 60...100 Health.

name: Tainted Flesh
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (20...39...44 seconds.) Foes who hit target ally in melee become Diseased (3...13...15 seconds); this ally is immune to Disease.

name: Taste of Death
description: Spell. Steals 100...340...400 Health from allied undead servant.

name: Taste of Pain
description: Spell. Heals you for 30...126...150. No effect unless target foe is below 50% Health.

name: Touch of Agony
description: Touch Skill. Deals 20...50...58 damage.

name: Toxic Chill
description: Elite Spell. Deals 15...63...75 cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (10...22...25 seconds) if target foe is hexed or enchanted.

name: Ulcerous Lungs
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near your target (10...22...25 seconds). Causes -4 Health degeneration to any of these foes that are Bleeding. Inflicts Bleeding (3...13...15 seconds) whenever these foes use a shout or chant.

name: Unholy Feast
description: Spell. Steals 10...54...65 Health from 1...3...4 foe[s] in the area around you.

name: Unholy Feast (PvP)
description: Spell. Steals 10...54...65 Health from 1...3...4 foe[s] in the area around you.

name: Vile Miasma
description: Hex Spell. Causes -1...4...5 Health degeneration (10 seconds). Initial effect: deals 10...54...65 cold damage. Hex is only applied if target foe has a condition.

name: Virulence
description: Elite Spell. Inflicts Disease, Poison, and Weakness conditions (3...13...15 seconds). No effect unless this foe already had a condition.

name: Vampiric Bite
description: Touch Skill. Steals 29...65...74 Health.

name: Vampiric Gaze
description: Spell. Steals 18...52...60 Health.

name: Vampiric Spirit
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Steal 5...41...50 Health from target foe. You have +5...9...10 Health regeneration (10 seconds).

name: Vampiric Swarm
description: Spell. Steals 15...51...60 Health. Hits 2 additional foes in the area.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Touch Skill. Steals 29...65...74 Health.

name: Verata's Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. (120...264...300 seconds.) Become master of all hostile undead servants in the area. End effect: your undead servants become masterless. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.

name: Verata's Gaze
description: Spell. Make target undead servant masterless. If it is already masterless, you become its master. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.

name: Verata's Sacrifice
description: Spell. (5...9...10 seconds.) 10 undead allied servants gain +10 Health regeneration. Instantly recharges if you have control of 3 or fewer servants. Transfers all conditions from those servants to you.

name: Vile Touch
description: Touch Skill. Deals 20...56...65 damage.

name: Vocal Minority
description: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes near target (5...17...20 seconds). These foes cannot use shouts or chants.

name: Wail of Doom
description: Elite Hex Spell. (1...3...4 second[s].) Target foe's attributes are 0.

name: Wallow's Bite
description: Touch Skill. Deals 20...50...58 damage.

name: Weaken Armor
description: Spell. Also affects adjacent foes. Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...17...20 seconds).

name: Weaken Knees
description: Elite Hex Spell. (1...13...16 second[s].) Target foe has -1...3...4 Health degeneration and takes 5...9...10 damage while moving.

name: Well of Blood
description: Well Spell. (8...18...20 seconds.) Allies in this well have +1...5...6 Health regeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of Darkness
description: Well Spell. (5...41...50 seconds.) Hexed foes in this well have 50% chance to miss. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of Power
description: Elite Well Spell. (8...18...20 seconds.) Allies in this well have +1...5...6 Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of Ruin
description: Well Spell. (5...25...30 seconds.) Inflicts Cracked Armor condition (5...17...20 seconds) to any foe in the well that takes physical damage. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of Silence
description: Well Spell. (10...26...30 seconds.) Foes in this well cannot use shouts and chants and have -1...3...4 Health degeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of Suffering
description: Well Spell. (10...26...30 seconds.) Foes in this well have -1...5...6 Health degeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of Weariness
description: Well Spell. (10...46...55 seconds.) Foes in this well have -1 Energy degeneration. Exploits a fresh corpse.

name: Well of the Profane
description: Well Spell. (8...18...20 seconds.) Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. Exploits a fresh corpse. 50% failure chance unless Death Magic 5 or more.

name: Wither
description: Elite Hex Spell. (5...29...35 seconds.) Causes -2...4...4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. Deals 15...63...75 damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.

name: Withering Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. (5...17...20 seconds.) Target ally's melee attacks cause Weakness condition (5...17...20 seconds.)
